label: Episode archive with portraits
description: A portrait-led chronological listing for podcast episode records. Each row combines a related maker image, compact episode metadata, editorial title, guest name, one-line summary, and an internal episode link.

fields.name: spacing
fields.note: Approved brand density. Raw CSS and numeric values are forbidden.

accessibility: Use semantic section, heading, list, and article structure in document order.
Provide meaningful alternative text for maker portraits; omit the image element when no meaningful image is available.
Make the complete episode row a single, clearly named internal link without nested interactive controls.
Render the approved button primitive as a non-nested visual action label within that link.
Preserve a high-contrast visible focus indicator with shape or outline, not colour alone.
Keep episode metadata and action labels readable at supported breakpoints.
Reserve stable 4:3 media dimensions to prevent layout shift.
Do not introduce audio playback, autoplay, scripts, iframes, or embedded media.
bespoke_gap: The approved archive variant intentionally hides images and summaries, while grid and featured variants are too card-like for fast chronological scanning. No approved variant combines compact archive scanning with maker recognition, summary context, and an explicit row action.

checks.reason: Embeds and third-party scripts need platform review unless explicitly allowlisted.
Slots are inside the tenant page-slot contract.
Composition uses the approved semantic spacing vocabulary.
Podcast/audio playback needs a trusted media-control package or platform review.
